text:
Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

We understand from your message that you are upset because a companion animal crate was not returned as expected and you believe the follow-up you received did not address the problem clearly. We are sorry for the stress this caused and we recognize that the care of a pet and its equipment should be handled with accuracy and respect.

When a crate cannot be located after travel, the most helpful next step is to file the claim through the usual baggage and animal services process and include all available trip details, identification labels, and supporting receipts. <<FACT F118>> Please also keep any messages, handoff tags, and travel documents together, as these help the review team confirm where the break in handling occurred.

Companion Animal Travel Desk <<FACT F112>> Our claims team uses that standard to begin review while also checking whether any additional handling notes or service exceptions apply. If the crate is recovered during the investigation, the team will coordinate the safest possible return route and provide updates through the contact information on file.

Our training guidance for staff is to keep the communication calm, humane, and complete when an animal travel issue is reported. That means we review the booking record, the transfer points, and the pickup process carefully, and we avoid making assumptions before the full file has been checked. If you were traveling with Scout or another pet, we also encourage you to mention any special handling notes so the record can be matched correctly.

We regret the inconvenience this incident has caused and appreciate the chance to correct it. Please continue to respond through the claims channel so the review can stay in one place and the supporting information can be attached to your case.

We will continue to assist until the matter is resolved.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
